summary: CNL Strategic Capital, LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting a routine monthly determination of net asset value per share as of March 31, 2026, along with a public offering price adjustment and a declared cash distribution. No special-situation event occurs: the filing describes standard NAV updates, subscription pricing, and a distribution declaration for a non-traded closed-end fund. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special situation. The document merely provides periodic operational and financial disclosures.
